newsitem.title: USA: US copper service center inventories rise in Nov.
newsitem.headline: US copper service center inventories rise in Nov.

text.p: U.S. service center copper stocks rose 4.7 percent in November over the previous month, while alloy inventories increased by 3.3 percent, the Copper and Brass Servicenter Association reported.
Although the average daily shipping rate climbed in November because of fewer business days than in October, total shipments in November fell 6.5 percent from the prior month.
Copper rod and bar shipments were off 17.1 percent while alloy rod and bar shipments were down 13.1 percent.

"We have been encouraged by a number of reports from servicenter executives who have indicated recently that their December shipments were considerably better than had been anticipated," the CBSA said in its monthly report.
